{{Quote|Senator Chuchi, you're given the authority to negotiate a peaceful settlement between the sovereign planet of Pantora and the Talz.|The representative to Senator Riyo Chuchi|<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref>}}
This '''Pantoran Assembly Representative''' was a member of the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]], the governing body of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]]. The representative and the rest of the assembly had the right to over-rule the Chairman if they wished to. When word reached the assembly that [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]] had a native population of [[Talz/Legends|Talz]], and that Chairman [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] had declared war on them to wipe them out, the assembly voted him out of order. They approved the proposal by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] to make peace with the Talz inhabitants of Orto Plutonia and declare their sovereignty over the frozen planet.
